findings.evidence: In-repo precedent for the same construction on bundled forms: `TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/Rescale.lean:68` `def rescale (ω : SymplecticForm V) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)` with `rescale_toBilinForm`; `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/TwoForm/Basic.lean:301` `protected def smul (c : ℝ) (form : SmoothTwoForm I M)`. Sibling constructions in this very namespace use verb names: `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Riemannian/Restriction.lean:134` `restrictOpenTangentSpace`. Mathlib's `conformal` family is predicates: `Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/ConformalLinearMap.lean:31` `isConformalMap_iff`.
findings.fix: Rename to `rescale` (or `smul`), and `conformal_inner` (line 76) to `rescale_inner`/`smul_inner`; update the use at UpperHalfSpace.lean:197,207 and the docstring at Conformal.lean:22. The file name `Conformal.lean` can stay.
findings.issue: `Bundle.ContMDiffRiemannianMetric.conformal` names a definition that returns a metric with a bare adjective: `g.conformal f hf hf_pos` reads as a predicate ("g is conformal"), especially next to Mathlib's Prop-valued `IsConformalMap`/`ConformalAt`. Naming rule 3/4 asks a definition to be named after its return value, which here is `f • g`; the file's own docstring calls it "the rescaled metric".

findings.evidence: Mathlib names the two-dimensional case by its model, not by its geometry: `Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane/Basic.lean` defines `UpperHalfPlane` with `im`, `coe`, `mk` and the underlying set as `abbrev upperHalfPlaneSet` (line 250). Conformal.lean:18-19 names the Poincaré ball model as another intended user. The repo's generic hyperbolic notions already exist as `TauCeti.HyperbolicMetric`/`IsHyperbolic` (TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Riemannian/Hyperbolic.lean:45,60).
findings.fix: Name the type after its model, mirroring Mathlib: `TauCeti.UpperHalfSpace` for the type and e.g. `TauCeti.upperHalfSpaceSet`/`upperHalfSpaceOpens` for the `Opens` (so the two do not differ only by case), renaming `HyperbolicSpace.*` accordingly; reserve `HyperbolicSpace` for a model-independent notion.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.HyperbolicSpace E` takes the model-independent name for one particular model; every declaration in its namespace is model-specific (`coe` into `WithLp 2 (E × ℝ)`, `height`, `similarity`), and the Poincaré ball model is already advertised as the next client of the new conformal construction, so it will need an unrelated name while `HyperbolicSpace` is spent on the half-space.

findings.evidence: Mathlib repeats the constructor on both factors in this situation: `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:389` `theorem diagonal_mul_diagonal`. The precedent for the inverse name is `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/End.lean:525` `theorem swap_inv`.
findings.fix: Rename to `similarity_mul_similarity`. (`similarity_inv` at line 355 is fine as is.)
findings.issue: `similarity_mul` states a product of two similarities (`similarity c hc b * similarity c' hc' b' = …`), but the name mentions only one factor, so it reads as a lemma about a similarity multiplied by an arbitrary element.

summary: Two name-form problems: `conformal` is an adjective naming a constructed metric (the repo already uses `rescale`/`smul` for exactly this), and `HyperbolicSpace` gives the generic name of hyperbolic space to one specific model whose whole API is model-specific. One minor lemma-name inconsistency with Mathlib precedent.
